title: a person outside an open metro joins its waitlist

criteria.text: Every US metro is in the list at signup
criteria.note: 296 metros seeded as the catalog; the picker offers all [V migration, `MetroWaitlistStep`] Checked: unmarked: `tests/migrations-metro-waitlist.test.ts`, `MetroWaitlistStep.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Zip may suggest a metro; never IP, default or nearest-match selection
criteria.note: Picker starts on a non-metro placeholder; F081 zip decides the member's metro. No zip shortlist built (optional: "may") [V] Checked: unmarked: `MetroWaitlistStep.test` "selects no metro for them"; nothing scans for IP/nearest.

criteria.text: Role is on the waitlist entry, none pre-selected, no role on the member
criteria.note: `metro_waitlist.role` check creator/patron, no default; radios unchecked [V]. Discarding the answer when the metro opens is not built (see 15) Checked: unmarked: `MetroWaitlistStep.test`, `MetroNotCoveredPanel.test` "pre-selects neither role"; no guard on `members`.

criteria.text: One person counts once in one metro, signed up or email only
criteria.note: Each path is idempotent alone (unique member index, unique `lower(email)` index, PR #191/#197). A person who leaves an address and later signs up holds two rows and counts twice; the member handler never reads the auth email [V] Checked: yes for each path alone (`waitlist-join*.test`, migrations tests), unmarked; cross case untested.

criteria.text: Changing metro moves the count, no double count or strand
criteria.note: Update plus down/up bump in one transaction, both handlers [V] Checked: unmarked: `waitlist-join.test`, `waitlist-join-anonymous.test`, `migrations-metro-waitlist-anonymous.test`.

criteria.text: Creator and patron counts stored separately, readable apart
A popup shows a count for everyone, from the cache
criteria.note: Anonymous path uses the cached figure (`waitlist-counts.ts`, PR #217). Signed-in path writes then reads the live counts and shows them [V `metro-waitlist-actions.ts`]; build log says "deliberately", the scenario says everyone Checked: yes for the anonymous path, unmarked: `MetroNotCoveredPanel.test`, `metro-waitlist-anonymous-actions.test`; signed-in asserts the live read.

criteria.text: One combined number against 300; same figure as the picker's ordering
criteria.note: Combined-only against 300 [V `metroStanding`]. Signed-in popup shows a different, fresher figure than the picker, up to an hour apart [V] Checked: unmarked: `waitlist-standing.test`, `MetroWaitlistStep.test` (the split is hidden; "same figure" untested).

criteria.text: Message says what is needed, never a date or a promise
criteria.note: `standingMessage` (remaining count only) [V] Checked: unmarked: `waitlist-standing.test`, `MetroNotCoveredPanel.test` "promises no date".

criteria.text: Eligible only at 50 creators and 250 patrons
criteria.note: `metroStanding.eligible` uses both thresholds [V]; nothing consumes it yet (no operator view) Checked: unmarked: `waitlist-standing.test` (49 creators at 300 is false).

criteria.text: Thresholds per metro, no migration or deploy
criteria.note: Per-metro columns, default 50 / 250, plain UPDATE [V] Checked: unmarked: `migrations-metro-waitlist.test` "lets a threshold be changed with an UPDATE".

criteria.text: Opening a metro is deliberate; crossing the threshold never opens it
criteria.note: No code writes `is_open` except the Sacramento seed [V grep]. The deliberate act is a raw database UPDATE; no operator path exists Checked: unmarked: handler tests assert no `is_open` write, two handlers only.

criteria.text: Leave an email, no account, no password, no name
Identical response for a new and a known address, same number
criteria.note: Result type has no flag or count; number comes from the cache, not the write [V] Checked: unmarked and mock-only: `waitlist-join-anonymous.test`, `metro-waitlist-anonymous-actions.test`. The build log records this exact test passing while false against Postgres; no real-database differencing test.

criteria.text: An address is used only to say the metro opened, then discarded
criteria.note: Addresses are stored and the panel states the single use. No send, no discard, no mail provider, no way to open a metro that triggers either [V grep] Checked: no (panel wording only: `MetroNotCoveredPanel.test`).

criteria.text: Metros are ordered by the cached waiting count
criteria.note: `withWaitingCounts` and `splitByOpen` sort not-yet metros by cached count, alphabetical tiebreak [V `feed-metro.ts`] Checked: unmarked: `feed-metro-sort.test`; no guard that the ordering path never reads live.
